label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 162 ]

blocks.text: Professional athletes do not agree on what their roles should be . Some star players believe that their role is to be a great player, not a role model for young people. They insist, “We’re not paid to be role models.” They strongly believe that what they do in their private lives is their own business. On the contrary, other star players disagree. They maintain that sports stars are role models for people even though they may not want to be. They say, “We do not choose to be role models. We are chosen. Our choice is whether to be good role models or bad ones.”

readingSentences.english: Language is not merely a collection of words, but a living reflection of culture.
readingSentences.korean: 언어는 단순한 단어들의 집합이 아니라 문화를 살아 숨 쉬게 반영하는 거울이다.

readingSentences.english: Idioms and expressions reveal how a community perceives time, honor, and nature.
readingSentences.korean: 관용구와 표현들은 한 공동체가 시간과 명예, 자연을 어떻게 인식하는지를 보여준다.

readingSentences.english: Learning a second language opens a window into an entirely new worldview.
readingSentences.korean: 외국어를 배우는 것은 완전히 새로운 세계관으로 통하는 창문을 열어준다.

readingSentences.english: It teaches us to look at our own assumptions from an empathetic perspective.
readingSentences.korean: 그것은 우리 자신의 고정관념을 타인의 공감 어린 시선에서 되돌아보도록 가르쳐 준다.
